fusions.name: Trellis Tangle
fusions.desc: Lashes one enemy within 6 tiles with a vine for 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. The target moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Deadheading
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. Cuts it for 18 damage, consumes every affliction on it and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the cut.

fusions.name: Second Flush
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Perennial Habit
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
